title: com.docker.sandbox/network-policy@1
description: Config schema for the phase-scoped egress policy need: install is open while the install hooks run and closed before the agent starts; runtime is what the agent gets. Singleton. The @1 in the type names this schema; it moves when the schema does.

networkRules.description: Allow/deny domain patterns (policykit glob semantics: * within a label, ** across labels, bare * matches any host). Deny wins.
